_comment: An SRB2 project is the game (its four pk3s are firmware) and, if it wants them, add-ons and save data.

slots.title: Add-ons
slots.help: Mods, levels and characters (.pk3, .wad, .soc, .lua), in load order, as SRB2's -file loads them. None for the game itself.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The game's progress to start from: gamedata.dat (unlocks, emblems, records) and save slots (srb2sav*.ssg), under those names, as Export Save Data writes them. None for a fresh game.
